newsitem.title: UK: Jermyn buys 14.8 mln stg property portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Jermyn buys 14.8 mln stg property portfolio.

text.p: Jermyn Investment Properties said on Friday it was buying a property portfolio from Friends' Provident for 14.8 million stg.
The consideration would be met by a new bank facility of 10.5 million stg and the rest from the proceeds of a placing and open offer of 2.75 million new shares at 190 pence each.
The company proposes to raise a net 4.48 million stg, of which 4.32 million will be partly used to fund the purchase from British mutual insurer Friends Provident.
Jermyn said in a statement the properties would provide an initial gross yield of 9.77 percent and immediately make a positive contribution to earnings.
The property portfolio comprises 15 retail and industrial properties and one office building. All the properties are freehold and fully let.
Ten of the properties are in the south and south-east of England, two in the Midlands/East Anglia and the remaining four in the north.
"We are pleased to announced the purchase of this well located portfolio which we firmly believe offers considerable upside potential for the company," said chairman Ray Horney.

"The acquisition fits well with our strategy of acquiring properties and portfolios with above average yields and which will benefit from a positive approach to their management". -- London newsroom +44 171 542 4365
